## What would improve?

Describe the documentation change or business outcome you would like explained.

## Fictional example

Use invented inputs only. Include no real messages, account details, private configuration, or client data.

## Scope and status

Which showcase document does this affect? If proposing a future capability, explain the need without describing it as available today.

## Boundaries

Describe any human decision or authorization the proposed workflow would need at a high level. Do not include private enforcement details.
